_comment: Supervised baseline benchmark on the COBRA BCC subset (research use only; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial).
Prerequisites: (1) import the subset with `python -m dermpath.importers.cobra ... --project proj-cobra-bcc-subset`
and let its ingest and QC jobs finish; (2) create and freeze a dataset version of that project whose config
declares "reference_standard": "imported_reference" (COBRA labels were extracted from pathology reports by a
rule-based method; they are imported reference labels, never expert reads) with a patient-grouped random
split that keeps a test split; the most recently frozen version is used (or set "dataset_version_id");
(3) midnight-12k needs WB_MIDNIGHT_WEIGHTS (obtained separately; nothing is downloaded).
Protocol: dev_cv with 5 patient-grouped stratified folds over train + val; threshold (Youden), Platt calibration
and abstention are chosen on out-of-fold predictions; the final model is refitted on the development pool; the
test split is NOT read (test metrics only through a recorded test release of a declared candidate).
Learning curves: nested stratified subsets of the development patients at 25, 50 and 100 % with 3 repeats.
Seeds (pre-declared 2026-10-28, before any multi-seed result): 0, 1, 2 for every encoder x head; the outer folds
depend on the development pool and k only, so they are identical across heads and seeds. Seed repeats measure
optimisation variability on the same patients, not additional independent patients.
name: COBRA supervised baseline benchmark
description: Encoder effects (handcrafted-stain-texture-v1 vs midnight-12k) with the head fixed and head effects (meanpool_logreg vs abmil) with the encoder fixed, on out-of-fold predictions of one frozen manifest.
